service.method: SELECT MODULE AS TREE_ID , MODULE , PARENT AS TREE_PARENT_ID , PARENT , DESCRIPTION AS TREE_VALUE , DESCRIPTION , OPTIONS , SORT , TYPE , NODE , REMARK , ALIAS , DEFAULT_OPTION_VALUE FROM SBMMA ORDER BY PARENT, SORT

WITH LINKED AS ( SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,MODULE ,CAST(PARENT AS VARCHAR) AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,PARENT ,COMBO ,CAST(PARENT + '_' + CAST(SORT AS VARCHAR) AS VARCHAR) AS TREE_ID ,DESCRIPTION ,SORT ,NODE ,TYPE ,OPTIONS ,ALIAS FROM SBMMA WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND PARENT = '*' UNION ALL SELECT BMMA.HOUSE_CODE ,BMMA.MODULE ,CAST(L.TREE_ID AS VARCHAR) ,BMMA.PARENT ,BMMA.COMBO ,CAST(L.TREE_ID + '_' + CAST(BMMA.SORT AS VARCHAR) AS VARCHAR) ,BMMA.DESCRIPTION ,BMMA.SORT ,BMMA.NODE ,BMMA.TYPE ,BMMA.OPTIONS ,BMMA.ALIAS FROM SBMMA BMMA JOIN LINKED L ON L.HOUSE_CODE = BMMA.HOUSE_CODE AND L.MODULE = BMMA.PARENT ) SELECT L.TREE_ID AS TREE_ID ,L.TREE_PARENT_ID AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,LANG.CONTENTS AS TREE_VALUE ,L.MODULE ,L.PARENT ,L.COMBO ,LANG.CONTENTS AS MODULE_NAME ,LANG2.CONTENTS AS DESCRIPTION ,CASE WHEN dbo.NVL(CMAM.MODULE, '_NOT_SELECTED_') = '_NOT_SELECTED_' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS USE_FLAG ,CMAM."OPTION" FROM LINKED L JOIN SLANG LANG ON L.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND LANG.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE' AND LANG.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND LANG.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG2 ON L.HOUSE_CODE = LANG2.HOUSE_CODE AND LANG2.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE_DES' AND LANG2.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND LANG2.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMAM CMAM ON CMAM.MODULE = L.MODULE AND CMAM.HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND CMAM.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY TREE_ID
SELECT MODULE ,OPTIONS FROM SCMAM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
